description: Estimates local average treatment effects at a policy threshold using regression discontinuity. Supports sharp RD (deterministic assignment) and fuzzy RD (probabilistic). Includes bandwidth sensitivity analysis and McCrary density test for manipulation detection.

running_var.description: Running (forcing) variable — assignment determined by threshold

cutoff.description: Threshold value of running_var that determines treatment

bandwidth.description: Bandwidth around cutoff: 'optimal' (Imbens-Kalyanaraman) or numeric value

treatment_var.description: Treatment indicator column (required for fuzzy RD)
